UT.name: Utah
UT.payments_rule: Transaction lines of $1,000 or more in purchasing categories, as posted (gross). A line is left out when a credit or reversal of the same amount to the same payee cancels it; smaller credits are not matched, so the lines can add up to more than the net yearly total. Descriptions that may identify a person are withheld.

ut_transparent_utah.name: Transparent Utah transaction lines
ut_transparent_utah.fiscal_year: Each entity's own fiscal year (cities, towns and districts mostly July-June, counties January-December), the year it ends in
ut_transparent_utah.note: Every expense line the agencies reported to Transparent Utah (BigQuery database), payroll, benefit and refund accounts left out; city, town and county lines coded fire. Lines uploaded again in a later batch are counted once, police lines of Lone Peak Public Safety District are left out.

ut_query_service.name: Transparent Utah public query service
ut_query_service.note: Fire district and interlocal agency details, total expenses, revenue and compensation (employee names replaced by numbers); not a documented API.

oh_checkbook_local.name: Ohio Checkbook, local governments
oh_checkbook_local.note: 186 participating fire agencies. Fire districts: whole checkbook. Townships: lines whose fund or department is named for fire and lines of program 220 (Public Safety, fire protection in the township chart of accounts), never lines named for police, so where a township also runs police its mixed Public Safety lines are left out. Cities and villages: only lines whose fund or department is named for fire; fire spending they book under general 'Public Safety' lines is not included. Lines identical in every column the checkbook publishes (row ids aside) are shown once, a voided and identically reissued payment as often as it was voided plus one, and identical voids of a payment as often as needed to keep its net as published. Most of the dollars are payroll, pensions and benefits paid through the checkbook. Participation is voluntary and uploads lag by entity (latest payment 2026-09-30); FY2026 partial

oh_cincinnati.name: City of Cincinnati Vendor Payments
oh_cincinnati.note: Cincinnati Fire Department only (department codes 224, 271, 272). Not included: fire apparatus and ambulances, which the City buys through its citywide vehicle account 981 (FY2021-FY2027: $18.7 million), and other purchases city departments make for Fire (fleet repairs, IT); P-card spend is paid to the card banks, so those merchants are not shown; FY2027 partial (payments through 2026-10-02)

ca_corona.name: City of Corona Open Expenditures (CorStat)
ca_corona.note: Corona Fire Department (department 30) payment lines, including pension and benefit payments; raw lines identical in every column but the row id kept once (no line number, so equal lines inside one invoice count once; payment, void and reissue keep their net); FY2026 partial (payments through 2026-06-30)

ca_fiscal.name: Open FI$Cal department vendor transactions (CAL FIRE)
ca_fiscal.note: CAL FIRE (state fire agency, business unit 3540), whole department: fire protection, State Fire Marshal and resource management; lines summed per voucher, payee, account, fund, program and date; CalCard purchases appear as payments to US Bank; the State publishes employee travel and training reimbursements to CONFIDENTIAL; raw lines identical in every column (document id included) kept once; FY2026 partial (postings through 2026-06-30)

ca_la.name: Checkbook L.A. (Los Angeles City Controller)
ca_la.fiscal_year: City of Los Angeles FY, Jul-Jun
ca_la.note: Los Angeles Fire Department (department 38) invoice lines; cancelled checks are negative lines; the City publishes most refunds of ambulance and fire service charges to PRIVACY-FIRE instead of the payee; raw lines identical in every column but the row id kept once (invoice, line and PO numbers are content, so separate invoice lines are all kept); purchases other City departments make for Fire are not included; FY2027 partial (payments through 2026-09-09)

ca_moreno_valley.name: City of Moreno Valley Open Expenditures
ca_moreno_valley.fiscal_year: City of Moreno Valley FY, Jul-Jun
ca_moreno_valley.note: Moreno Valley Fire Department (departments Fire Operations, Fire Prevention and Fire - Office of Emergency Mgmt) invoice lines; most dollars are the City's contract payments to the County of Riverside for fire staffing (CAL FIRE operated); raw lines identical in every column but the row id kept once; purchases other City departments make for Fire are not included; FY2026 partial (payments through 2026-06-24)

ca_riverside_county.name: County of Riverside Check Book (Riverside County Fire Department)

ca_sco_cities.name: California State Controller, City Financial Transactions Reports (fire function)

FY2024 (2023-24) is the latest year the SCO has published

ca_sco_districts.name: California State Controller, Special Districts Financial Transactions Reports

ca_scprs.name: SCPRS Purchase Order Data (CAL FIRE purchase orders)

ca_sf.name: San Francisco Vendor Payments (Vouchers)
